Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of data on scheduled electricity outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatic collection, parsing, visualization (HTML) and automatic generation of PNG images of charts of scheduled/emergency power outages in Ukraine.

The project receives data from open web pages of suppliers and stores it in JSON 'as is' in the `data/` directory. Next, this data is displayed in a fixed HTML template and converted to PNG images, which are stored in `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data Format
Each region is stored in the file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for a week for each group (weekly template). Stored 'as is' without structure normalization.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
```

# D2RHub

**Diablo II: Resurrected multi-account, dual-client and audio telemetry farming assistant**

---

D2RHub is a Windows local tool for managing multiple accounts of Diablo II: Resurrected, Chinese/International client configurations and multi-instance processes, and recording rune drops and local statistics through mod audio fingerprinting.

Currently only one desktop distribution is maintained: the multi-instance core is always available, desktop floating window, recognition and statistics, desktop pet and automatic room following as built-in optional modules added as needed. MSI and NSIS are only different installation formats, not two functional versions.

### v0.9.102 Update

- Optimized D2R startup detection: Calculate the key window to skip animation from recognizing new processes, and immediately stop sending after detecting ETW or TCP 1119 readiness.
- Tightened WEB_TOKEN ETW listening to only receive QueryValue events, and increased real-time tracking buffer to reduce the risk of loss under high-frequency registry events.
- This release does not modify Mod or game files, no need to reprocess Mod when upgrading from v0.9.101.

- Added **Mini Mode** to the main window: keep only account list, launch button and task status, window can be pinned to top; startup failure results are retained in the mini window, click to expand details.
- Added **Memory Cleanup** to startup batch: when the number of successful launches reaches half (rounded up) and when the batch ends, consolidate the working set of launched windows, which can be turned off in 'Application Behavior'.
- Auto room following input timing redone: main account and sub-account unified as 'press Ctrl → lead time → press A/V → hold → release A/V → delay release Ctrl → interval', form wait and Ctrl lead time can be set separately, and added **Restore Default Timing** button.
- Sub-account room entry interval supports **0.5–60 seconds**.
- Clicking 'Switch Back' in mini mode can directly bring the corresponding game window to the foreground.
- This release does not modify Mod or game files, no need to reprocess Mod when upgrading from v0.9.100.

### v0.9.100 Update

- Auto room following no longer locks the keyboard and mouse of the entire desktop, nor resets the mouse or forces to take back the foreground.
- Clipboard changed to independent data backup, fixed misjudgment of paste interruption; stops pasting and retains new content when external replacement is detected.
- Clean up form and password cache after creation failure, avoid sending multiple Esc after manually closing the form and retrying, and record the specific failure reason.
- Auto room following wait after room creation supports **0.5–60 seconds**.
- Auto-input uses configured step interval uniformly, wait 100 milliseconds after form opens; added independent key combination hold time, default 100 milliseconds, can be set to 10–1000 milliseconds.
- BongoCat retains cross-screen, negative coordinates and off-screen positions, scaling and monitor changes no longer auto-pull back, still can manually reset.
- No need to reprocess Mod for this fix when upgrading from v0.9.99.

# options-monitor

`options-monitor` is a locally-run, human-decision-first options monitoring system. It chains together market data, cash, equity positions, options ledger, strategy rules, reports, and notifications into an auditable workflow to help users accomplish:

- Candidate screening for `Cash-Secured Put (CSP)` and `Covered Call (CC)`;
- Evaluation of `Combo Yield` combination candidates;
- Continue managing purchased stocks and seeking income and exit opportunities after `CSP` assignment;
- `Close Advice` for opened options lots;
- Queries of options profit, cash flows, positions, and expiration lifecycle;
- Daily Decision Brief, candidate change alerts, and offline strategy reviews.

It is not an automated trading system and will not place orders on behalf of users. Candidates, close advice, and research conclusions are advisory-only; actual trading, configuration writes, notification sends, service changes, and production status modifications must go through their respective explicit confirmation boundaries.

## Core Boundaries

The system has only one main execution flow:

```text
config.yaml
├─ om config build --market us|hk
│  └─ config.us.json / config.hk.json
│     └─ om run tick | om run tick-cron
│        └─ output_runs + output_shared + output_accounts
└─ om config build-assistant
   └─ resolved/config.assistant.json
```

Options positions have only one truth chain:

```text
trade_events -> projection -> position_lots
```

- `config.yaml` is the manually-edited source; generated JSON is a run snapshot, not a daily manual editing entry point.
- Local SQLite is the truth source for options trades and positions; Feishu does not host `option_positions` mirror.
- Regular manual `tick` does not automatically send scheduled ordinary notifications; production scheduling uses protected `tick-cron`.
- `./om-agent spec` is the authoritative catalog of Tool Gateway tool names, input schemas, risk levels, and side effects.
- When market data, fees, historical exchange rates, events, or identity facts are missing, the system explicitly returns missing, partial, or not-evaluable; it does not fabricate data.

See [Product Architecture](https://github.com/liuxie066/options-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md) for the product domain, technical call chain...

oil-oil/oil-visual.description: Create unified comic ink-line style explanation diagrams and transparent character illustrations for concepts, processes, comparisons, and article graphics.
oil-oil/oil-visual.body:
Using a unified set of comic ink-line style, create two types of ready-to-use images: one type is complete explanation diagrams with short labels that can independently explain concepts or processes; the other type is transparent illustration materials that can be placed in presentations, articles, or cards. Transparent materials can feature only a bespectacled stick figure, a warm-yellow Border Collie, a combination of both, or only objects like folders and tools. Characters appear as needed for the composition, and objects don't require adding a person or dog to maintain the style. ## Image Style - Use clear and bold black ink lines to draw outlines and details. - Use circular halftone dots to represent gray surfaces and shadows, without using soft gradients. - A minimalist bespectacled stick figure with round glasses and a chubby warm-yellow Border Collie are optional characters that can appear alone, together, or not at all. - Objects and decorative elements follow the same set of outlines, ink lines, halftone dots, and restrained color palette, without automatically adding characters. - Complete explanation diagrams use a beige paper texture, retaining only a few environmental objects that truly help with understanding; standalone illustrations are delivered with transparent backgrounds. - The dog uses warm yellow when present; when there's no dog, warm yellow can be used as light accents or not at all. Each image can use up to two additional semantic colors. - When text is needed in images, use short and accurate sans-serif labels placed directly on the corresponding objects. ## Examples ### Complete Explanation Diagrams

The same set of ink lines, halftone dots, and semantic colors can represent mechanisms, comparisons, cycles, bottlenecks, and information organization. ### Transparent Materials in Presentations

The left image generates only a bespectacled stick figure; the right image generates objects like finding a folder and cutting away messy paper strips. Titles, descriptions, and connecting lines in both slides are arranged by the presentation, while the illustrations remain transparent and text-free. ## Installation Pass the [oil-visual repository address](https://github.com/oil-oil/oil-visual) to the Agent and request to install this Skill; you can also use the command: ```bash npx skills add oil-oil/oil-visual ``` Have the current host reload the Skill, then call it by name in the conversation: ```text Use $oil-visual to explain how the main Agent assigns work to subagents. Use short, exact Chinese labels inside the image. ``` ```text Use $oil-visual to draw the glasses stick figure reviewing a blueprint, with the warm-yellow Border Collie sitting beside the desk. ``` ```text Use $oil-visual to draw a single stick figure holding a pencil, transparent background, no dog. Use $oil-visual to draw a single warm-yellow Border Collie sitting, transparent background, no people. Use $oil-visual to draw a folder in the same style and several scattered papers, transparent background, no people or dogs. Use $oil-visual to draw several star-shaped decorative elements in the same style, transparent background, no characters. ```…

xalor888/Maodouchat.body:
# Maodouchat

Maodouchat (Maudou Chat) is an end-to-end encrypted Android instant messaging application: Jetpack Compose client + Ktor backend. Covers one-on-one chat/group chat, feeds, audio and video calls, Signal protocol E2EE, encrypted attachments, optional AI capabilities and admin panel.

For feature list and completeness, see [`docs/feature-inventory.md`](https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat/blob/HEAD/docs/feature-inventory.md); for Bot API, see [`docs/bot-developer-api.md`](https://github.com/xalor888/Maodouchat/blob/HEAD/docs/bot-developer-api.md).

## Technology Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|---|
| Client | Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room + SQLCipher, WorkManager |
| Realtime | WebSocket `/ws` + REST fallback |
| Encryption | libsignal-client (1:1 sessions + group Sender Key), attachment AES-256-GCM |
| Calls | WebRTC (1:1 + group mesh), TURN short-term credentials |
| Server | Ktor, Exposed, JWT, PostgreSQL |
| Deployment | Docker Compose (Caddy + Postgres + server) |

## Environment Requirements

- **JDK 21**: Mandatory requirement for Gradle builds in this repository; do not use JDK 25 to run Gradle.
- Android Studio / Android SDK, `compileSdk = 37`.

Common commands:

```bash
# App
./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest

# Server (independent project)
cd server && ../gradlew compileKotlin test

# Website end-to-end tests (requires local Ktor to be running)
npm run test:website
```

On macOS, you can use `export JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)` to set JDK; on Windows, use `source scripts/use-jdk21.sh` or configure `org.gradle.java.home` in `~/.gradle/gradle.properties`.

yyh-001/DSH-X.body:
· · ·

DeepSeek Harness lightweight launcher. Pick a version, start DSH web. > [!IMPORTANT] > **DSH-X launches the official DeepSeek Harness Web page, not the desktop version.** > It is only responsible for version installation, launching, and plugin management. It does not embed WebView, nor does it modify or remake DSH's web interface. DSH-X itself is a community open-source project and is not an official DeepSeek product. ## Features - **Pick and use a version**: Launch / Stop / Restart / Update / Uninstall - **macOS support**: Native `.app` and dmg installation packages (separate versions for Apple Silicon / Intel), auto-update, autostart on boot, and directory selection all use native system methods - **Plugin page**: List installed plugins with one-click toggles, check and update plugins (individual / all), profile switching available here - **Compatibility mode**: Automatically disable problematic plugins based on error messages on startup failure (one-click recovery available); self-check client plugin packages referenced on the page after startup, management page provides conclusions (distinguish instance issues from stale tabs) - **Dark appearance**: Follow system settings or manually specify, with floating window transparency and character avatar toggle - **Launch acceleration**: Equivalent fast implementation at the bundle composition point (saves approximately 1–2 seconds), automatically skipped after DSH upgrades - **Plugins follow official releases**: Data stored in user directory `.dsh`, no need to reinstall plugins when switching versions - **Update keeps old versions**: Only retain the latest and most recently installed versions (sufficient for rollback), older versions automatically cleaned up after installation - **Resident in background**: Does not exit when closing the web page (Windows tray / macOS menu bar icon), interface uses system browser - **Includes Node / npm / pnpm**: Installation package includes portable runtime and npmmirror mirror source, plugin installation does not depend on system environment - **Only one version runs at a time**: Avoids different versions competing for ports and data - **Pre-install marketplace on first setup**: Can automatically install `dshmarket` Communication / Feedback: **QQ Group [993579665](https://qm.qq.com/q/7AD2g70HqS)** ([Click to join](https://qm.qq.com/q/7AD2g70HqS)) ## UI Preview

zhugecaomao/ALTRun.body:
ALTRun

Lightweight, efficient, open-source Windows launcher, operation habits refer to Alfred on macOS
A lightweight, Alfred-style launcher for Windows, written in AutoHotkey v2

## Quick Start 1. Download the [latest version](https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/releases/latest) and extract it to any folder; or install [AutoHotkey v2](https://www.autohotkey.com/) and directly run `ALTRun.ahk` from the source code 2. Press `Alt+Space` to bring up the search window, type a name, and press `Enter` to open 3. Press `Ctrl+,` to open Preferences, modify hotkeys, themes, indexing scope, etc. Portable and green, no registry writes: settings are saved in `ALTRun.json` in the program directory. **Upgrading from older versions**: Exit the old version, extract the new version to the original folder to replace `ALTRun.exe`, and run it again. On first run, it automatically imports the old `ALTRun.ini` (settings, custom commands, hotkeys), and the original file remains unchanged (see [Installation and Upgrade](https://github.com/zhugecaomao/ALTRun/wiki/Installation)). ## Features **Search** - **Alfred-style search window**: Search as you type, each line displays title + path/description, window height adjusts with results, 9 built-in themes - **Applications**: Automatically indexes Start Menu, Desktop, and Microsoft Store apps; Chinese names support pinyin initials ("wx" → WeChat); unwanted apps can be removed from results by pressing `Ctrl+Del` - **Files and folders**: Like Alfred, first press `Space` in an empty search box then type the name (or `'报告` / `open 报告`); [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) queries the entire disk at runtime, otherwise uses built-in indexing (Desktop, Documents, Downloads) - **Custom commands**: Files, folders, programs + parameters, URLs, can set keywords; also match by target folder name / file name; after renaming a folder, can check with one click which commands' paths are invalid - **Learning sorting**: Remember what was typed...
